content.value_statement: Animation work can fail when motion is not seek-safe or visually provable. This skill helps define deterministic keyframes and verify them with focused HyperFrames diagnostics.
actual_capabilities: Selects appropriate keyframe mechanisms for 2D, SVG, text, UI, canvas, and 3D motion.
Defines deterministic runtime rules for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, and WAAPI animations.
Guides visible subject states, final holds, and continuity checks for animated compositions.
Recommends focused HyperFrames diagnostics for linting, validation, keyframe inspection, shots, ghosts, and snapshots.
Explains common failure modes such as endpoint-only motion, identity breaks, fake depth, and unreadable text.
limitations: It does not create broad scene strategy, brand systems, captions, or general video plans.
It assumes the user already has a HyperFrames project and compatible animation libraries.
It provides guidance and examples, not a standalone runnable animation package.
Some referenced plugins or runtimes may require separate installation or licensing.

use_cases.title: Repair Animation Proof
use_cases.description: Diagnose why a HyperFrames animation lacks visible middle poses, final holds, or stable subject identity.

use_cases.title: Choose Keyframe Mechanisms
use_cases.description: Map a desired motion effect to GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, SVG, or 3D mechanisms.

use_cases.title: Verify Render Safety
use_cases.description: Check that keyframes are deterministic, seek-safe, and backed by snapshots at important proof times.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Motion
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one animated subject
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to plan seek-safe motion for this composition. Identify the subject, start pose, proof pose, final pose, and verification times.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Runtime
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to choose the smallest animation mechanism for this motion. Compare GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, SVG, and 3D options.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Failed Proof
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to diagnose this failed animation proof. Explain which subject, channel, timing, or diagnostic should change first.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Complex Depth
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to review this 3D or canvas animation. Check camera motion, object transforms, occlusion, ghost views, and final snapshots.

output_examples.input: A product card should move into a detail panel without looking like a crossfade.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends preserving one subject identity, using a shared element or FLIP approach, and verifying source, middle, and final states.

output_examples.input: A WebGL object appears flat during a depth transition.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests adding camera or z motion, proving occlusion with a ghost view, and checking snapshots from diagnostic angles.

output_examples.input: Text animation looks impressive but becomes unreadable mid-shot.
output_examples.output: The skill prioritizes readable line boxes, smaller displacement, longer final holds, and snapshots at text-heavy proof frames.

best_practices: Name the animated subject and every visible pose before choosing a runtime.
Use deterministic timing, finite loops, and registered runtime instances for render-critical motion.
Verify painted pixels with focused diagnostics instead of relying only on logs.
anti_patterns: Do not use timers, hover events, scroll triggers, or unseeded randomness for render-critical motion.
Do not split one continuous movement into unrelated tweens without a visible reason.
Do not hide broken full-frame results behind helper-selector shots or debug overlays.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps build deterministic HyperFrames keyframes and verify that animated motion is visible, continuous, and seek-safe.

faq.question: Does it write complete scene concepts?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on keyframe mechanics, runtime rules, diagnostics, and animation proof inside an existing composition.

faq.question: Which animation systems does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, SVG mechanisms, DOM 3D, Three.js, and WebGL patterns.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents diagnostic checks for a HyperFrames project. Users should approve command execution in their own environment.

faq.question: Can it help with text animation?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes readable line boxes, word spacing, final fit, and snapshots at frames where text must remain legible.

faq.question: When should I use another skill?
faq.answer: Use a broader animation or planning skill when you need scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or full video planning.
